C1315.title: Proofpoint Detects Large-Scale AiTM Phishing Attack Bypassing MFA
C1315.summary: In April 2025, Proofpoint detected multiple AiTM campaigns using the Tycoon 2FA phishing-as-a-service platform against thousands of organizations worldwide. Spoofed Microsoft 365 authentication pages stole usernames, passwords, 2FA tokens, and session cookies to bypass MFA. The campaigns also used invisible Unicode characters, custom CAPTCHAs, and anti-debugging features to evade detection.
